newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Investment leading Australia growth - Costello.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Investment leading Australia growth - Costello.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday strong investment was leading the country's economic growth.
"What you're seeing is economic growth being led by investment and that's just what you'd want to see as you look down the track," Costello told reporters.
"It's particularly satisfying to see that the investment figures were so strong and indeed, even stronger than the capex figures which came out last week," he said.
Non-dwelling construction gross fixed capital expenditure rose 10.6 percent in the September quarter, compared with 2.4 percent in the June quarter.
Equipment gross fixed capital expenditure lifted 6.9 percent in the September quarter, compared with a 0.1 percent fall the previous quarter.
Figures last week showed private new capital expenditure rose 0.9 percent in the September quarter, against forecasts which had centred on a 3.0 percent fall.
Overall, Australia's seasonally adjusted average gross domestic product rose 0.8 percent in the September quarter for an annual rate of 3.8 percent.
